name: REDcode
author: Edgemodders
description: REDcode's service for other packages and assistants: the WolvenKit project open in REDcode (VS Code), and when it changes; the game's window mode and resolution, for REDcode's game tab; V's place, and openSector, which opens a sector in REDcode at a node. REDcode installs and updates this package; it has no window.
